No. Of the 81.3 hectares of 2021 tree-cover loss counted as an event, 68.1 hectares overlapped mapped pine plantation and 13.2 hectares were outside mapped forest. None overlapped mapped native forest.

A further 37.3 hectares of loss occurred in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares and was not counted as an event; its forest-type location is not provided. The evidence does not establish the cause of the loss.
